entities.name: Boro Jovanović
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Boro Jovanović was a Yugoslav and Croatian tennis player. Jovanović was runner-up in the 1962 Wimbledon doubles tournament with Nikola Pilić, and quarter-finalist in the 1968 Wimbledon doubles tournament. In singles, Jovanović reached the final of the 1963 Italian Open and the quarterfinals of the 1968 French Open. In 1972, Boro Jovanović joined the World Championship Tennis Tour. He was ranked World No. 8 for 1963 by Lance Tingay of The Daily Telegraph. Jovanović died on 19 December 2023, at the age of 84.
